release_summary:
Release 0.11.119: Global Bank's Characters page by Gameforge account, sent mail grouped by send, a Transfer log page and gold per server; the mail window loads new mail and gets past full bags; zBag stats on gear in a colour per stat; KittyCombo can press a skill just before its cooldown ends.

Global Bank 1.6.15 and Global Bank for RoM extension 1.4.5: the Characters page groups characters under one heading per Gameforge account with its RoM accounts under it. A Gameforge account's name copies with a click, its hover says Password missing when none is saved, and characters the site showed with the same e-mail address link to one account by themselves. A character renamed in a transfer is followed under its new name instead of counting its items twice. The Gold overview shows each server's gold before the Total. The Mail page's Sent list puts the mails sent together on one line with their items as pictures, with its own search and a Compact tick; sent mail has its real time and each character keeps 2,400. A Transfer log page lists every transfer still under way. Also since 0.11.118: RoM account names and Gameforge e-mail addresses from the Runes of Magic site's transfer and account pages, no save dropped while the game is busy with it (a missed logout is found within 30 seconds), a Cascade game windows button, single-character accounts in one group, and an Addons page that no longer offers an older release as an update.

Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck17: with a portable mailbox open, Inbox loads mail that came in meanwhile; Recent and Mine keep to the server you play on; with full bags, Take all leaves the mails with items and still takes the gold mails behind them; Mass send always offers Send safely next to Send fast, and /umm is laid out in sections with a tooltip on everything and Default speeds. Also 7.0.1-ck16: items from the open arcane transmutor can be mailed; 7.0.1-ck15: Ctrl+A, a click in a filled To selects the name, pasted line breaks come without extra carriage returns, and a paste that puts nothing in the box says why.

zBag 5.07-ck22: Stats labels also show on gear and on the bank's slots; a single stat's name has its own colour (Stat colours... in /zb, or /zb colors) and its icon an outline in its tooltip colour; German stat names.

KittyCombo 1.7.19: a Press early (s) condition lets a row fire its skill up to that many seconds before the client shows it ready (0.75 by default) and wait for it instead of casting lower rows, paced to stay under the client's limit on repeated cast requests. Given to the attack rows below the top skill as well, it lets them go out right after it instead of waiting for their icons. Rows without it behave as before, and older versions refuse share codes that use it.

LogNextChar 1.4.1: Prev above Next, and a Logout button beside them for an ordinary logout (also /lnc logout). Cherry's Chat 0.11.4: tabs and line breaks in a chat line, as in party adverts from addons such as ComeOnIn, show as spaces. Cherry's Bar 1.1.11: a Show server name with clock tick. Hub 0.4.35 with setup 1.3.0: the guided setup also updates Global Bank's Chrome extension when it is older than the release's. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and files byte for byte.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 1608 tests; 1407 passed and 201 skipped (Windows PowerShell or retired), none failing. New tests cover Global Bank's account tree, account links by e-mail, renamed transfers, sent mail items and times, the Transfer log, busy saves, single-character groups and the window cascade; the mail window's inbox reload, per-server names, Take all with full bags, transmutor items and paste handling; zBag's gear labels and stat colours; LogNextChar's Prev, Next and Logout; KittyCombo's Press early pacing against a model of the client and server cooldown timing; Cherry's Chat's control characters; Cherry's Bar's server name; and the setup's extension catch-up and newer-copy rules. The release build verifies all 17 install packages, and every package that kept its version is byte for byte the one in 0.11.118, so setup and the Addons page offer exactly the changed ones. Not yet checked in game or in Chrome: UM28-UM34, Z4, Z6-Z7, CB6, KE1-KE6, TL1-TL4, SM1-SM7 and CT1-CT10 in docs/TESTING.md, and LogNextChar 1.4.1's new button layout and Logout.

standalone_packages.title: LogNextChar
standalone_packages.summary: Next and Prev buttons that log you straight into the neighbouring character, with its own login screen: gets past a stuck server list, saved logins, keyboard controls.

origin.note: Install login screen.bat, or the guided setup, moves those folders to `Interface\offloaded_addons` for you, along with `CherrysKit\CherrysLoginxmlHook` from before Cherry's Loginxml became part of this addon. The login screen itself is Rom Autologin by Pyrrhus with fixes, and has to live in `Interface\loginxml`, the only place the game reads one: the same installer updates what is there, copies the old folder to `Interface\offloaded_addons` first, and keeps your saved logins.

works_with.for: shows each character's gold and last save on the character screen and the helper's status on the server screen, and gives it your account's character list, which boxes them together on its page and fills in their servers
closes its window before switching characters, as it does the game's mail window

standalone_packages.after_install: close the game and run `!setup_cherryskit.bat`, or double-click `Interface\AddOns\CherrysKit\LogNextChar\Install login screen.bat`. The game only reads a login screen from `Interface\loginxml`, so this copies it there. Until then, Next and Prev only log you out.

external_packages.title: zMail
external_packages.summary: pyrr's mailbox addon, as an alternative to Ultimate Mail Mod. Its own folder Interface\AddOns\zmail, unchanged except one fix: mails with gold it can't take (gold cap) are no longer opened, so they keep their 30 days instead of 3.
external_packages.upstream: zMail 1.4 by pyrr (CurseForge). zMail is pyrr's project; Cherry's Kit has no connection with it other than distributing it, with pyrr's permission.
changes: src/inbox.lua: only read the attached item's count for mails without gold (data.money == 0), so mails with gold beyond the cap aren't opened.
data/chars.lua: shipped empty (the original listed test characters).
CHANGES.txt left out; CherrysKit-version.txt added so the setup can tell this copy from a CurseForge one.
